messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync: drafting a reserve contingency playbook for Dedicated capacity. Need decisions on: 1) when to trigger contingency spillover, 2) billing treatment for spilled burst, 3) customer-specified headroom windows. Thoughts?

devon_eng: +1. Do we want an explicit SLA-triggered spill or heuristic based on observed queue latency? Prefer SLA-triggered for predictability.

sasha_research: SLA-triggered makes sense, but also want a short predictive window to avoid oscillation. can we add a 'preemptive buffer' that kicks in when 95th latency > SLO for 2 min?

lee_oncall: oncall prefers deterministic triggers. heuristic windows make paging noisy. if predictive buffer then require a suppress window and clear escalation paths.

tim_sales: customers asked for 'graceful spill' during product launches. They want advance notice and billing clarity. We should allow a one-off waive for first 6 hours per month.

maria_pm: Good point @tim_sales. Proposal sketch:
- Trigger: SLA breach for >2m OR sustained queue > 80% for 5m
- Action: spill to elastic pool or compatible lighter model
- Billing: spilled tokens billed at 'burst-rate' unless waived per commercial terms
- Customer controls: reserve headroom window (HOURS/day), opt-in predictable spill

devon_eng: Implementation notes:
```yaml
trigger:
  type: sla_or_occupancy
  sla_window_seconds: 120
  occupancy_threshold_pct: 80
  occupancy_window_seconds: 300
actions:
  - route_to: elastic_pool
  - fallback_model: smaller_quantized
  - notify: oncall + customer
``` 

sasha_research: Also add quality guard: if fallback model reduces NRR > X then throttle instead of fallback.

lee_oncall: add a 'runbook step 0' to verify capacity metrics and escalate to infra before automatic restraint. we can't auto-throttle without ops approval for some customers.

maria_pm: For launch gating, set minimum onboarding checklist:
- customer selects headroom hours
- billing term for spills agreed
- alerting hooks tested (webhooks)
- canary route exercises fallback path

tim_sales: ok to add 'first-month spill waiver' as sales option. need finance sign-off on waiver counts.

devon_eng: FYI this will require changes in the routing service + quota service. estimate: 2 sprints to build trigger + route, 1 sprint for billing hook.

maria_pm: Decision items for next week:
1) Approve SLA vs heuristic hybrid trigger (vote)
2) Approve billing default (burst-rate, with optional waiver)
3) Approve runbook gating steps

sasha_research: vote: hybrid (SLA primary + predictive buffer)

devon_eng: vote: SLA primary (deterministic) — but ok hybrid if suppress windows enforced

lee_oncall: vote: SLA primary + suppression windows

tim_sales: vote: hybrid (sales needs predictive + waiver)

maria_pm: Tally: hybrid wins (4/3 incl. preference). I'll draft a formal spec and attach to this thread. Action: @devon_eng to prototype trigger logic, @lee_oncall to draft runbook checklist, @tim_sales to coordinate waiver terms with finance.

opsbot: Deploy reminder scheduled: weekly sync on Monday 09:00 UTC — add 'reserve-contingency' agenda item :calendar:

maria_pm: Thanks all. I'll drop the first spec draft by EOD Friday and ping stakeholders for a 30m review.
